description_en: This API is used to perform a pre-check before upgrading the major version of RDS MySQL or RDS PostgreSQL
description_zh: 该接口用于执行RDS MySQL及RDS PostgreSQL大版本升级前检查
name: UpgradeDBInstanceMajorVersionPrecheck

parameters.description_en: The ID of the instance. You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~610396~~) operation to query the ID of the instance.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/610396.html operation to query the ID of the instance
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.description_en: The new major engine version of the instance. The new major engine version must be later than the original major engine version.
parameters.description_zh: 目标实例版本，必须大于当前实例版本。
parameters.help_en: The new major engine version of the instance. The new major engine version must be later than the original major engine version
parameters.help_zh: 目标实例版本，必须大于当前实例版本
parameters.name: target_major_version

parameters.description_en:
Upgrade mode. Valid values:  

- **zeroDownTimeUpgrade**: Zero downtime.  
- **inPlaceUpgrade**: In-place upgrade.  
- **greenBlueDeployment**: Blue-green deployment.
parameters.description_zh:
